To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
Response Surface Methodology can be used as an effective tool to optimize the formulation of low salt chicken nuggets with good quality and stability.
Response Surface Methodology can be used for optimization of low salt reconstituted chicken nugget and the product can be developed with a shelf life of 25 days under refrigeration.
low salt restructured meat products can be successfully produced with acceptable sensory quality and shelf life by the use of Response Surface Methodolgy (RSM).
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of low salt reconstituted chicken nuggets by RSM and its quality evaluation.
the development of low salt re-structured chicken nugget using RSM and evaluation of the product quality.
the development of low salt re-structured chicken nuggets using RSM.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the low salt restructured nuggets with the optimized level of ingredients were comparable to control in terms of physicochemical, textural and sensory properties.
the low salt nuggets with the optimized level of the four ingredients had a comparable quality to control nuggets and can be a good alternative to the control nuggets in terms of saltiness.

the low salt restructured nuggets can be produced using the optimized levels of NaCl (0·75%), KCl (0·70%), whey protein (1·18%) and black gram (2·5%) and the product would be acceptable in terms of physicochemical, instrumental and sensory properties.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
a low salt (0.75% NaCl) restructured chicken nuggett can be prepared by the addition of 1.18 % whey protein, 0.70 % KCl and 2.50 % black gram flour.
the developed low salt chicken nuggets with 0.75 % NaCl were acceptable to the consumer.
low salt restructured nuggets can be developed by using RSM.
The main takeaway from our work is that
low salt chicken nuggets with good sensory and textural quality can be produced using the response surface methodology.
low salt restructured nuggets can be developed with the use of response surface methodology and that the developed nuggets are acceptable in quality to the consumer.

it is possible to reduce salt content in chicken nuggets without compromising their overall acceptability, texture or shelf life by optimizing the levels of salt replacers and protein and fiber rich ingredients.
